notes.title: New Title Screen!
notes.notes:
In celebration of the Halloween I am publishing a small update with our new title screen.

Hope I can be able to include new content to the game as well during the season.

Have fun!

notes.title: New character - Human Nurse
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new character arrives in DeadShotZ: Human Nurse. Meet the new survivor Sheila Pinheiro. Her unique feature is that she can collect more First Aid kits compared to the other characters.

Her stats are similar to the Elf Cop, with lower speed.

Have fun!

notes.title: Xmas Update - Orc Gangster + Dwarf Mechanic + more
notes.notes:
Merry Xmas!

In this special update I have finally included new characters in the game:

[h2]Orc Gangster[/h2]

[b]Urug Bog[/b] is the new leader of a mafia group. He got this role after his boss died in the zombie apocalypse. He can survive longer than the other characters on the game. It needs more than a bite to stop this guy.

[h2]Dwarf Mechanic[/h2]

[b]Asubela Coinrock[/b] is a mechanic that got her workshop destroyed on the apocalypse. Now she tries to survive and recover her business in the process, if that's even possible. She can collect more coins than the other characters.

Both characters are slower than the Elf Cop, but more resistant to damage.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

I have fixed the Flamethrower sound and animations. Also fixed the store of the bought status of the same weapon (sometimes it was not registering the purchase, sorry about that!). Fixed the dialog navigation when using a controller.

[h2]Remote Play + Steam Cloud[/h2]

The game will now be available for remote play (phone, tablet or TV). And also feature cloud saves!

Have fun and take care!

notes.title: Demon Purge Saga out on Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I have just published a new game on Early Access: Demon Purge Saga. It is as match-3 game with exorcism theme. You play as Father Emmet and must purge all the evil from the Parabollam Village. To do this you will count on Father's Desmond help.

Go ahead and buy the game below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444950/Demon_Purge_Saga/

The game for now have only the first 10 levels. On the official launch I plan to include more 60 levels.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Halloween Update - Characters + lore + flamethrower + new achievements and more
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and happy Halloween month!

To celebrate this month I launched a really interesting update to the game, this time not just adding new items to existing mechanics but also changing the concept of the game a bit. Here's what we have:

[h2]The Game Lore[/h2]

Beside being only a hyper casual shooter game DeadShotZ now will feature lore: get yourself into this universe filled with fantasy characters in a modern post-apocalyptic setting! 

DeadShotZ will feature many characters based on classic fantasy tales like elves, orcs and dwarves. All of them living in a world just like ours, having common issues (except for this zombie apocalypse of course, caused by social network companies).

[h2]Introducing Characters[/h2]

To start showing these characters you can now know better Elaith Umenorin, our existing main character. He is our proud elf cop. He is fast to move around. And will be able to show some special racial traits to fight the zombies. Stay tuned on the next updates!

[h2]The Flamethrower[/h2]

Another classic weapon from classic zombie games arrives on DeadShotZ. This weapon have one of the faster shootings with a big area of contact, it's value is comparable to the Rocket Launcher (also have the same price).

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

Along with the new weapon I have included the achievement for it. Also, the other new weapons achievements were missing and got added (Stun Gun and Shotgun).

[h2]New Configurations[/h2]

I have improved the game menu by including separate configurations for audio volume and fullscreen/windowed modes.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the music playing on the intro credits screen
[*] Blocked the F12 usage in-game
[*] Included the Credits screen (developers)
[*] Moved some elements in the HUD of the game to match the new characters feature
[*] 2 new musics to reduce too much repetition
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: New enemies + weapons + bugfixes 1.3.0
notes.notes:
We finally included new enemies and weapons in this update! 

Now you can find and fight dogs, crows, rats, worms, and a surprise monster. All of these monsters will try to kill you, each of them with different attributes and speed. Some are available everywhere, others only on specific environments. The surprise enemy will be available only on the laboratory.

The new weapons are Stun Gun, an electric weapon, and the famous Shotgun. The Stun Gun is a close-range weapon (the first in the game). Be aware of the usage delay! The Shotgun is a regular weapon with a twist: it can kill multiple enemies in the shot path.

Beside these awesome new stuff we also fixed some issues with the controller usage, removed the remaining pause button from the old mobile version, included a fullscreen mode (you can exit it with F11), fixed some german translations and added the current weapon icon on the HUD (this will be more useful in a future update!).

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Controller + German update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This second regular update brings the German translation to the game. You can change the game language in the title screen just like in the past version.

We also added the support for gamepad controller! The game will automatically switch between the mouse + keyboard or the gamepad when you start using it.

In the gamepad mode the aim is not present in the main game screen, used only by navigating the menus.

Since the game have simple commands, we bound multiple keys to every action to match the player preferences.

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Achievements update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
This new update brings basic stuff that was missing in the launch of the game, but was already being worked.

[list]
[*] As requested by the community we just included the achievements in the game! These achievements are grouped around the main features of the game: from killing zombies and scoring combos to buying weapons.

You can see the list of the game achievements in this link: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1180110/achievements/

[*] We included the trailer song in the title screen and on more interactive ones.

[*] The game now supports Brazilian portuguese! You can change the game language in the title screen.

[*] When you kill multiple enemies in the interval of 2 seconds your combo gauche will show. It's another way to score in the game.

[*] We made some changes in the inventory screen and included the area titles in the HUD.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this first udpate! More to come!
